title: Send proposal / offer
subject: Proposal for {{project_name}}
content:
Hi {{name}},

thank you for the conversation — it was great to learn more about what you need.

ai_prompt: Write a professional email to {{name}} sending a proposal for {{project_name}}. Mention the proposal is attached. Offer a quick call to walk through it. Keep it friendly and under 80 words.
